players.name: Virgil van Dijk
players.note: Still world class at 34, but a clear step down from the 96 of 2018/19 — rated for this season, not the peak.

players.name: Dominik Szoboszlai
players.note: Elite all-round midfielder — range of passing, set pieces, and the versatility to fill in at right-back without dropping off.

players.name: Ibrahima Konaté
players.note: Physically among the best centre-backs in the league; the concentration lapses keep him out of the 85+ band.

players.name: Ryan Gravenberch
players.note: One of the league’s best deep midfielders — press resistance and ball carrying at a level almost nobody else in this file reaches.

players.name: Alexis Mac Allister
players.note: A World Cup winner and a complete central midfielder; two league goals is output, not a ceiling.

players.name: Florian Wirtz
players.note: Rated on ability rather than a difficult first season in England. Five goals in twenty-seven starts is well below what he produced in Germany, but the between-the-lines creativity that made him one of Europe’s outstanding young players did not disappear on the plane.

players.name: Alisson
players.note: One of the outstanding goalkeepers of the era, but thirty-two and past the peak that would have put him alongside Schmeichel’s 93.

players.name: Mohamed Salah
players.note: His peak seasons would sit in the mid-nineties; this is thirty-three-year-old Salah, still a serious threat but visibly slower and producing seven goals in twenty-three starts. Rated for the season, not the career.

players.name: Hugo Ekitike
players.note: Complete modern centre-forward profile - movement, link play and finishing - a rung below the elite band on consistency.

players.name: Curtis Jones
players.note: Rotation-plus midfielder for a title-calibre side; technically excellent and press-resistant without being a difference-maker.

players.name: Andy Robertson
players.note: Some way past the 2018-20 peak that would rate around 90 — at 31 a rotation left-back, but still a good one.

players.name: Giorgi Mamardashvili
players.note: Georgia's first choice and an outstanding shot-stopper at Valencia; rated as a very good modern keeper who is a deputy here by circumstance, not standard.

players.name: Alexander Isak
players.note: Elite modern centre-forward — pace, both feet, finishing at a genuinely high level. The disrupted summer and thin return here are circumstance, not a drop in ability.

players.name: Joe Gomez
players.note: Technically excellent and comfortable at centre-back or right-back, but years of injury have left him a rotation defender rather than a starter.

players.name: Rio Ngumoha
players.note: Sixteen years old and already trusted for real minutes by a title-winning side, with a match-winning goal. Rated as a high-end rotation option now, not on his ceiling.

players.name: Federico Chiesa
players.note: Highest in this batch by some way. A Euro 2020 winner and former Serie A young player of the year used as an impact substitute; injuries have cost him a tier but have not made him ordinary.
